answer: Because the counters live in the atlas ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. An operator running many aliases thus forfeits for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the willow quota and the orchard admission check. Submission rate is limited to 2 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole farm from one uplink. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
